The Apify MCP server...allows AI applications and agents to interact with the Apify platform using Model Context Protocol (MCP).

result.notes: REST API secured by bearer token (Apify API token, found in Console under Integrations); token can also be passed as URL query param. MCP server (mcp.apify.com) additionally supports OAuth for AI agent connections. Free tier ($5/mo platform credit, no credit card) makes self-serve dev access straightforward. Large API surface covering Actors, datasets, key-value stores, tasks, webhooks, schedules, etc.
result.one_liner: Apify is a web scraping and automation platform where developers run/build "Actors" (scrapers/crawlers) via a large REST API, with an official MCP server for AI agent access.
